card.title: Say You Missed Me
card.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, can you admit the flat was too quiet without me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You first. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I rang our landline just to hear your voice. Could you say 'hello' without asking about the gas bill?

mechanism: A elicits an explicit admission of missing A before revealing their own attachment through phone calls.
confusable: Unlike mutual openness from the start, A must enforce the other person's vulnerable admission first.
comparison: D88-a sequences key-listening before landline confession; D88-b sequences keeping a chair before admitting sleeping with its cushion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
